All 10 pages captured: Devpost counts 223 submissions and lists 222 publicly; prize names from each of the 48 winning project pages.

curator_notes: All 48 prize winners are analyzed records. Coverage is partial because one of the 223 submissions is not public, so counts are not base rates. The two Best Bitcamp Hack winners are podium without rank (first and second exist, but pages do not show which is which); People's Choice is public-vote-ranked. Team size is not stated on Devpost. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively.
